Initial release of dlazy-mj.imagine.

- Generate artistic images using the Midjourney (MJ) model with text-to-image support.
- Provides flexible options for prompts, aspect ratios, bot type selection (MID_JOURNEY or NIJI_JOURNEY), and output formatting.

- Explicit guidance for handling missing credits or API key scenarios.
- Documentation includes trigger keywords and essential agent instructions for execution.
